MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which pair of initials both use a puff of air? (1 mark)
   A. p and t
   B. m and n
   C. b and g
   D. b and d

2. What is pinyin? (1 mark)
   A. A system that writes Mandarin sounds with letters
   B. A kind of Chinese food
   C. A type of pen
   D. A Chinese number

3. Read the pinyin: zhè shì wǒ māma. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my father.
   B. This is my mother.
   C. There are five people in my family.
   D. That is my older brother.

4. Which word means "younger sister"? (1 mark)
   A. 女儿 nǚ'ér
   B. 姐姐 jiějie
   C. 妹妹 mèimei
   D. 妈妈 māma

5. Fill the blank: 这是____妈妈。 (This is my mum.) (1 mark)
   A. 我
   B. 你
   C. 谁
   D. 什么

6. What does 卧室 (wòshì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. On
   B. In front of
   C. Chair
   D. Bedroom

7. Which day is 星期四? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. Tuesday
   C. Thursday
   D. Friday

8. Why should we listen kindly when friends explain how they celebrate? (1 mark)
   A. Only one way is right
   B. It wastes time
   C. It is not important
   D. Families celebrate in different ways and all are meaningful

9. In the text 今天是我的生日。朋友们来我家。我很高兴。 what is the main idea? (1 mark)
   A. A sad day
   B. A lesson at school
   C. A happy birthday with friends
   D. A trip to the market

10. What does 切 (qiē) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To cut
   B. Friend
   C. To wish
   D. They

11. Which word is pronounced mǐfàn? (1 mark)
   A. 米饭
   B. 饼
   C. 葡萄
   D. 香蕉

12. Which Chinese word means "to touch"? (1 mark)
   A. 哭 kū
   B. 肩膀 jiānbǎng
   C. 摸 mō
   D. 用 yòng

13. What does 看 (kàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To look, to see
   B. Shoulder
   C. To wash hands
   D. Mouth

14. What does 下雨 (xià yǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Weather
   B. There is not
   C. It rains
   D. Wind

15. What is a good safety tip in strong rain? (1 mark)
   A. Stay away from fast rivers
   B. Shelter under a tall tree in a storm
   C. Play near the river
   D. Ignore warnings

16. What should you do first when you get a spoken instruction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess
   B. Walk away
   C. Act at once
   D. Listen to the whole instruction

17. Which word means "beside"? (1 mark)
   A. 旁边
   B. 下面
   C. 里
   D. 上面

18. What does 是 (shì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Older sister
   B. Daughter
   C. Love
   D. Is, am, are

19. What does 厕所 (cèsuǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Garden
   B. Toilet
   C. Left side
   D. Is at, is in

20. What does 周 (zhōu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Week (short form)
   B. To rest
   C. Tomorrow
   D. School

21. Read the pinyin: péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. We sing.
   B. We cut the cake.
   C. My friend gives me a gift.
   D. When is your birthday?

22. How can you stay safe with a digital reading journal? (1 mark)
   A. Use it without asking
   B. Ask an adult first and share only with your teacher and class
   C. Share it with strangers
   D. Post your address online

23. Which word is pronounced wǎnfàn? (1 mark)
   A. 晚饭
   B. 蔬菜
   C. 香蕉
   D. 咖啡

24. What does 蔬菜 (shūcài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Lunch
   C. Mango
   D. Chicken (meat)

25. What does 小 (xiǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Small
   B. Sun
   C. Not
   D. It rains

26. Which sentence means "The weather is very good today."? (1 mark)
   A. 雨很大。
   B. 今天天气很好。
   C. 今天有云。
   D. 今天下雨。

27. On which vowel does the tone mark go in nǐ? (1 mark)
   A. No vowel
   B. n
   C. u
   D. i

28. Read the pinyin: zhè shì wǒ jiějie. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Who is this?
   B. That is my younger brother.
   C. This is my older sister.
   D. This is my father.

29. Why is correct spelling with tones important? (1 mark)
   A. Only capital letters matter
   B. Tones do not matter
   C. Only characters matter
   D. A wrong tone can change the meaning

30. Which Chinese word means "toilet"? (1 mark)
   A. 上面 shàngmiàn
   B. 前面 qiánmiàn
   C. 桌子 zhuōzi
   D. 厕所 cèsuǒ

31. Which Chinese word means "one"? (1 mark)
   A. 二 èr
   B. 五 wǔ
   C. 四 sì
   D. 一 yī

32. Read the pinyin: xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Wednesday I go to school.
   B. On Saturday I rest at home.
   C. On Friday, go to the mosque.
   D. On Sunday, go to church.

33. Which sentence is written on a birthday card? (1 mark)
   A. 我叫小明。
   B. 祝你生日快乐!
   C. 你好吗?
   D. 再见!

34. Which two characters share 肉? (1 mark)
   A. 茶 and 咖啡
   B. 水 and 牛奶
   C. 牛肉 and 鸡肉
   D. 米饭 and 蛋糕

35. Which Chinese word means "tooth"? (1 mark)
   A. 摸 mō
   B. 看 kàn
   C. 牙 yá
   D. 用 yòng

36. Which sentence means "I use my ears to hear."? (1 mark)
   A. 我用眼睛看。
   B. 我用耳朵听。
   C. 我用嘴巴说。
   D. 我有两只眼睛。

37. Which sentence means "The wind is very light."? (1 mark)
   A. 雨很大。
   B. 风很小。
   C. 今天下雨。
   D. 今天天气很好。

38. What does 天 (tiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sky, day
   B. Rain
   C. Drought
   D. Snow

39. Which Chinese word means "rain"? (1 mark)
   A. 天气 tiānqì
   B. 没有 méiyǒu
   C. 刮风 guā fēng
   D. 雨 yǔ

40. Which stroke is written first in 左? (1 mark)
   A. 横 héng
   B. 竖 shù
   C. 撇 piě
   D. 点 diǎn

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write a plan for a model house: name four rooms or things in Chinese with pinyin and write one sentence about it. (4 marks)

42. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Good morning!" (2 marks)

43. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing. (2 marks)

44. What does it mean to listen for gist? Give one way to do it. (2 marks)

45. Write the question for "Who is this?" and answer it with "This is my father", with pinyin. (2 marks)

46. Draw a plan of a home with a garden, door, window and sofa and write four sentences about where things are, in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

47. Name two fruits, one vegetable and one drink in Chinese with pinyin. (3 marks)

48. Explain what the part 女 tells us in 妈, 姐 and 妹. (3 marks)

49. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "That is my younger brother." (2 marks)

50. Give two habits for keeping your body clean. (2 marks)

51. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today it rains." (2 marks)

52. Decide whether each statement is 对 or 错 and explain. Text: 今天有太阳,没有雨。 Statement: 今天有雨。 (3 marks)

53. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 窗户 and 大家. (2 marks)

54. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I like to eat bananas." (3 marks)

55. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期一 and 几. (2 marks)

56. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello, teacher!" (2 marks)

57. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: yǔ hěn dà. (2 marks)

58. What is the job of 吗 in a sentence? Give an example. (2 marks)

59. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Who is this?" (2 marks)

60. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 明天 and 二. (2 marks)

61. Give two things to put in a reading journal. (2 marks)

62. Read and translate: 星期一到星期五,去学校。 (3 marks)

63. Name one kind of extreme weather. Say what causes it and give one safety tip. (4 marks)

64. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — p and t
   p, t and k are said with a puff of air.

2. A — A system that writes Mandarin sounds with letters
   Pinyin uses the same letters as English and Kiswahili to show how Mandarin sounds.

3. B — This is my mother.
   zhè shì wǒ māma. is 这是我妈妈。, which means "This is my mother.".

4. C — 妹妹 mèimei
   妹妹 is a younger sister and 姐姐 is an older sister.

5. A — 我
   我 means my.

6. D — Bedroom
   卧室 (wòshì) means bedroom.

7. C — Thursday
   四 is four, so 星期四 is week four, Thursday.

8. D — Families celebrate in different ways and all are meaningful
   Respect for different ways of celebrating is important.

9. C — A happy birthday with friends
   The text is about a birthday, friends coming and being happy.

10. A — To cut
   切 (qiē) means to cut.

11. A — 米饭
   米饭 is pronounced mǐfàn and means cooked rice.

12. C — 摸 mō
   摸 (mō) means to touch.

13. A — To look, to see
   看 (kàn) means to look, to see.

14. C — It rains
   下雨 (xià yǔ) means it rains.

15. A — Stay away from fast rivers
   Floods are dangerous and fast rivers are unsafe.

16. D — Listen to the whole instruction
   You need the whole message to follow it correctly.

17. A — 旁边
   旁边 pángbiān is beside.

18. D — Is, am, are
   是 (shì) means is, am, are.

19. B — Toilet
   厕所 (cèsuǒ) means toilet.

20. A — Week (short form)
   周 (zhōu) means week (short form).

21. C — My friend gives me a gift.
   péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù. is 朋友送我礼物。, which means "My friend gives me a gift.".

22. B — Ask an adult first and share only with your teacher and class
   Keep personal information private.

23. A — 晚饭
   晚饭 is pronounced wǎnfàn and means dinner.

24. A — Vegetables
   蔬菜 (shūcài) means vegetables.

25. A — Small
   小 (xiǎo) means small.

26. B — 今天天气很好。
   今天天气很好。 (jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.) means "The weather is very good today.".

27. D — i
   The only vowel is i, and the mark replaces its dot.

28. C — This is my older sister.
   zhè shì wǒ jiějie. is 这是我姐姐。, which means "This is my older sister.".

29. D — A wrong tone can change the meaning
   chuáng and chuāng are different words.

30. D — 厕所 cèsuǒ
   厕所 (cèsuǒ) means toilet.

31. D — 一 yī
   一 (yī) means one.

32. D — On Sunday, go to church.
   xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng. is 星期天,去教堂。, which means "On Sunday, go to church.".

33. B — 祝你生日快乐!
   祝你生日快乐 is happy birthday to you.

34. C — 牛肉 and 鸡肉
   牛肉 is beef and 鸡肉 is chicken.

35. C — 牙 yá
   牙 (yá) means tooth.

36. B — 我用耳朵听。
   我用耳朵听。 (wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.) means "I use my ears to hear.".

37. B — 风很小。
   风很小。 (fēng hěn xiǎo.) means "The wind is very light.".

38. A — Sky, day
   天 (tiān) means sky, day.

39. D — 雨 yǔ
   雨 (yǔ) means rain.

40. A — 横 héng
   左 begins with the horizontal stroke.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example 厨房 chúfáng, 客厅 kètīng, 卧室 wòshì, 床 chuáng. Sentence: 床在卧室。
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name with pinyin, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 早上好! zǎoshang hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have two eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Listening for gist means finding the main idea. You can listen for key words you already know.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for a method.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi? 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question and 1 mark for the answer.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian. 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān. 窗户在沙发上面。 chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn. 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the plan and 1 mark for each correct sentence.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo, 菠菜 bōcài, 茶 chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fruits, 1 mark for vegetable, 1 mark for drink.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: 女 means woman or female, so the characters are for female family members.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the link to family, 1 mark for naming the three characters.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 那是我弟弟。 nà shì wǒ dìdi.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wash your hands with soap (洗手), brush your teeth (刷牙), bathe often, wear clean clothes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: 错. The text says there is no rain (没有雨).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 错, 1 mark for finding 没有, 1 mark for the explanation.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: 窗户: chuānghu, window. 大家: dàjiā, everybody.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢吃香蕉。 wǒ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期一: xīngqīyī, Monday. 几: jǐ, which number, how many.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: 老师好! lǎoshī hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: The rain is heavy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: 吗 makes a yes-or-no question, for example 电视在桌子上吗?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the job and 1 mark for the example.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: 明天: míngtiān, tomorrow. 二: èr, two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: New words with pinyin and meaning, sentences you can read well, or a recording of yourself reading.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, qù xuéxiào. From Monday to Friday, go to school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin and 2 marks for the meaning.

63. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example a flood: it is caused by too much heavy rain. Stay away from fast rivers. (A drought is caused by too little rain. Save water.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the event, 1 mark for the cause, 2 marks for a safety tip with a reason.

64. (2 marks)
   Answer: On Wednesday I go to school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.
